title: S4-EXPORT-05 — A Godot kit opens as a bundle.
goal: The Godot kit preflight describes a valid atlas for Bun; asking for a normal-map atlas without a normal layer is flagged in the preflight and the download is refused with the reason; without it the kit is ready again, and the artwork stays exact.

steps.why: The preflight describes the atlas it will write.

steps.text: Normal export needs exactly one Normal Facets or Normal Map layer in every frame
steps.why: The normal atlas states what it requires.
The preflight names the frame that lacks a normal source.

steps.alert: Normal export needs exactly one full-opacity Normal Facets or Normal Map layer
steps.why: The download is refused with the reason, and the dialog stays open.
No kit was written: the export dialog is still open.
Without the normal atlas the kit is ready again.
The export is ready; this plan does not start the browser download (the file itself is checked outside the App run).
Preflight and refusal never change the drawing.

cliOnly: opening the ZIP: manifest, atlas, animation resources and the normal atlas when one valid source exists (tests/production/gameDelivery.spec.ts, scripts/testsprite/pixibun-explicit-normal-sources-integrity.py)
